title: Graduation Ceremony 2022｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University

summary.lead: The 4th year undergraduate students (4th class) and 2nd year master's students (2nd class) graduated.

overview: Graduation and degree conferment ceremonies were held for the fourth-year undergraduate students and second-year master's students in the class of 2024! Congratulations to all graduates! Finally, We sincerely wish you all further growth and success as you begin your journey into the working world♪
